title: Grok Develops a Construction Instinct: Speak and It Can Generate a Website and Application with a Domain Name; xAI Brings the Chatbox to the Development Desk

content_html:
Elon Musk's xAI has added a new capability to Grok. The mode called Build is now officially launched, translating users' natural language prompts directly into products with independent domains - no lines of code needed. Just describe your idea out loud, and the creation can be previewed in real-time and refined repeatedly right before your eyes.

This mode is currently still in an early beta version, with the barrier deliberately set to the highest level: only available to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers who pay 300 dollars per month, and can be used on multiple devices. The products it can generate are quite extensive, including websites, functional applications, games, and real-time dashboards. Once the work is completed, it can be published externally through links on grok.me, or bound to the user's own custom domain. A single idea can thus be transformed by AI from a thought into a truly accessible online product.

Looking further, the Build mode reveals xAI's larger ambitions. It marks that Grok is expanding from a companion that chats with you to an end-to-end development platform - users are no longer just asking questions, but can directly "build" their ideas within the same interface. This path coincides with several AI programming tools on the market, and the competition is now burning from chatting all the way to building.

content_html_zh:
Elon Musk 的 xAI 为 Grok 添加了一项新功能。 Build模式现已正式上线，将用户的自然语言提示直接翻译成具有独立领域的产品，无需任何代码。 只需大声描述您的想法，创作就可以在您眼前实时预览并反复完善。

该模式目前还处于早期测试版本，门槛特意设置为最高：仅适用于每月支付 300 美元的 SuperGrok Heavy 订阅者，并且可以在多个设备上使用。 它可以生成的产品相当广泛，包括网站、功能应用、游戏和实时仪表板。 工作完成后，可以通过 grok.me 上的链接对外发布，或者绑定到用户自己的自定义域。 因此，人工智能可以将单个想法从想法转变为真正可访问的在线产品。

进一步来看，构建模式揭示了 xAI 更大的野心。 这标志着Grok正在从一个与你聊天的伴侣扩展到一个端到端的开发平台——用户不再只是提出问题，而是可以在同一个界面中直接“构建”他们的想法。 这条道路与市场上的几种人工智能编程工具不谋而合，现在竞争已经从聊天一路烧到了构建。
